shots.title: Split self-authored review notes from independent review evidence in gate state (#561)
shots.notes: Sprint state now stores review_gates separately from raw gate booleans and normalizes legacy state to pending review provenance.

shots.title: Require reviewer provenance, PR review URL, or explicit weaker-mode override before review gates pass (#561)
shots.notes: Review gates now require independent reviewer evidence, PR review evidence, self-review rationale, or manual override rationale before they can complete.

shots.title: Prompt Codex to create purpose-built reviewer agents from sprint hazards and artifacts (#562)
shots.notes: Review recommendation and PR guard paths now derive purpose-built reviewer agent specs with lane, focus, scope, and evidence requirements.

shots.title: Add status/help/tests that make self-review visibly distinct from independent review (#561, #562)
shots.notes: Sprint status, session briefing, help metadata, and agent status now show review provenance explicitly and keep boolean-only review gates pending.

conditions.description: The sprint touched core lifecycle state, CLI gates, guard prompts, review recommendation output, and agent-facing status, so evidence had to stay explicit across several surfaces.

training.description: Review gate booleans are not enough to prove independent review.
training.outcome: Review completion now has typed provenance and validation for independent_review, pr_review, self_review, and manual_override.

training.description: Legacy sprint-state files need safe normalization instead of silent trust.
training.outcome: Missing, partial, or invalid review_gates load as pending unless they contain valid evidence.

training.description: Reviewer-agent prompts need artifact-scoped evidence requirements, not generic review language.
training.outcome: Review guidance now asks for purpose-built reviewer agents and evidence that includes agent identity, lane, verdict, required fixes, and fix handling.

nutrition.description: Focused review-gate and reviewer-agent suites passed during the sprint: sprint-state, sprint-gate, agent status, session briefing, review findings, PR review guard, and PR finalize coverage.
S219-4 status/help coverage verifies self_review is visibly weaker than independent_review and that boolean-only review gates remain pending.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: The sprint was wider than the first issue title suggested because provenance needed to be enforced, rendered, and recommended consistently.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: Treat review evidence as a first-class contract. If no independent reviewer actually ran, record self_review or manual_override explicitly instead of implying stronger evidence.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: Agent status and session briefing were easy to miss because they consumed raw gate booleans outside the main sprint status path.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: S220 can build on clearer review evidence while it repairs audit trail and retro parsing gaps.

bunker_locations: Review gates need both structured provenance and user-visible labels, or self-review can still appear equivalent to independent review.
Derived status surfaces should use the same pending-gate helper as completion logic.
Purpose-built reviewer-agent guidance is only useful if it states the expected evidence fields up front.
yardage_book_updates: src/cli/sprint-state.ts now normalizes review_gates and exposes evidence-aware pending gate names.
src/cli/commands/sprint.ts now rejects bare review gate completion and renders review provenance in sprint status.
src/cli/reviewer-agents.ts derives purpose-built reviewer agent specs from review recommendations and sprint context.
src/cli/commands/review-state.ts and src/cli/commands/review-run.ts now include purpose-built reviewer-agent guidance and evidence requirements.
src/cli/commands/agent.ts and src/cli/guards/session-briefing.ts now treat review gates as pending until valid provenance exists.
course_management_notes: GitHub issues #561 and #562 are addressed by commits 1970399, f481748, ff57cc2, and 6c6bcbe.
The sprint intentionally leaves unrelated dirty hook and slope-loop files untouched.
Closeout review gates are recorded as self_review/manual_override unless an actual independent reviewer or PR review evidence is available.
